column1: 155,346 reports from Oct 25, 2025 to Oct 25, 2026: 80% resolved, 12% still open, 6% canceled.
Half of resolved reports were fixed within 3 days. The average is 11.7 days, because a smaller number take much longer.
The most reported issue is Trash / Recycling / Bulky Services (25,772 reports, 17% of all).
Of the 10 most common issues, Property Violations is the slowest to fix: a typical one takes 13 days.
The busiest area is ZIP 64130, with 11,478 reports, most often Property Violations.
District 3 has the most reports (34,778); District 1 has the fewest (14,342).
19,333 reports are still open, and 9,253 of them (48%) have waited more than 90 days. The oldest opened in this period has been waiting 365 days (Trash / Recycling / Bulky Services).
Reports per year went from 131,719 in 2022 to 167,089 in 2025 (+27%), comparing the first and last full years of data.
The busiest month was June 2026 (18,029 reports); the quietest was February 2026 (9,986).
The most common way to report is Phone Answered (45%), then iOS (24%).
Wednesday is the busiest day, and weekends get about 34% of a weekday's reports. 79% arrive between 8 AM and 6 PM.
875 addresses were reported 10 or more times. Some are city buildings rather than problem spots; see the Repeat addresses tab.
The city team handling the most reports is PW Solid Waste (45,795).
